verdict.rationale: Pipedream is a workflow automation platform, so durable long-running execution is a fair axis. The evidence pack documents only automatic retries of errored events and error notifications. Nothing shows workflows that pause or wait for days, or that persist execution state across worker or platform restarts. The only execution-duration evidence is a community report of short per-execution timeouts (10s for HTTP triggers, 30s for cron), which points away from long-lived workflows.
